settings.repere: Texte · What's the difference between the bundle
settings.text: What's the difference between the bundles?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The face tanner lasts up to 4–6 months,
settings.text: The face tanner lasts up to 4–6 months, and each body tanner gives you 10–12 full-body tans. So the Starter Bundle (1 face, 1 body, 1 mitt) keeps you covered for a while. The King Bundle adds a back applicator for full coverage. The Double Body Bundle gives you 2 body tanners (20–24 full-body tans) plus a mitt - perfect if you already have the face tanner.

settings.repere: Texte · What's the difference between Original a
settings.text: What's the difference between Original and Darker?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Original gives you a natural, sun-kissed
settings.text: Original gives you a natural, sun-kissed glow - like you just got back from a long weekend. Darker goes deeper for a richer bronze. If you're new to self-tanning, start with Original. You can always go Darker next time.

settings.repere: Texte · How long will a bundle last?
settings.text: How long will a bundle last?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · The Starter Bundle lasts most guys 2–3 m
settings.text: The Starter Bundle lasts most guys 2–3 months with regular use. The face tanner can last around 4-5 months, itself, and the body tanner has around 8-12 full-body applications. The King Bundle doubles the body tanner supply, so you're looking at 4+ months.

settings.repere: Texte · Can I mix Original and Darker?
settings.text: Can I mix Original and Darker?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Not within a single bundle - each bundle
settings.text: Not within a single bundle - each bundle comes in one shade. But you can absolutely buy an Original bundle and a Darker face tanner separately if you want to experiment. Some guys go Darker on the body and Original on the face.

settings.repere: Texte · How long does a bottle last?
settings.text: How long does a bottle last?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · One bottle lasts approximately 2–4 month
settings.text: One bottle lasts approximately 2–4 months depending on usage. That works out to roughly 2–3 cents per application. It's one of the most affordable tans you can get.

settings.repere: Texte · Do I need the Back Tan Applicator?
settings.text: Do I need the Back Tan Applicator?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · If you want full coverage including your
settings.text: If you want full coverage including your back, yes. The mitt handles everything you can reach, but unless you're a yoga instructor, your back is a two-person job without the applicator. It's one of the most-added items at checkout for a reason.

settings.repere: Texte · Is it hard to apply?
settings.text: Is it hard to apply?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Not at all. Spray the face tanner onto y
settings.text: Not at all. Spray the face tanner onto your hands and rub it in like moisturizer. For the body, shake the bottle, pump foam onto the mitt, and work from your legs up. The whole routine takes about 5 minutes. Apply before bed, wake up tan.

settings.repere: Texte · Will people know it's fake?
settings.text: Will people know it's fake?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · No. Both formulas use DHA, the same acti
settings.text: No. Both formulas use DHA, the same active ingredient derived from beetroot. It reacts with your skin to create a natural-looking color - no orange, no streaks. The most common reaction we hear is "did you go on vacation?"

settings.repere: Texte · Will it stain my sheets?
settings.text: Will it stain my sheets?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Nope. Our formula is clear, water-based,
settings.text: Nope. Our formula is clear, water-based, and doesn't contain any dyes. The color won't transfer to your pillows, bedding, or clothing.

settings.repere: Texte · I have sensitive skin. Is this safe for
settings.text: I have sensitive skin. Is this safe for me?

settings.repere: Paragraphe · Yes. The face tanner is water-based, fra
settings.text: Yes. The face tanner is water-based, fragrance-free, and formulated for sensitive skin. The body tanner is a lightweight foam with no harsh chemicals.
